name: Apollo 17 Landing Site
summary: Apollo 17 was the final Apollo mission to land astronauts on the Moon.
hook: I was the final Apollo human landing site in the Taurus-Littrow valley in 1972.
how_it_worked: Supported the longest human stay on the lunar surface: over 74 hours with three moonwalks.
science: Discovered orange soil beads formed by ancient volcanic fire-fountain eruptions on the Moon.

facts.text: Harrison Schmitt, the Lunar Module Pilot on Apollo 17, was the first professional geologist on the Moon.
The crew traveled over 35 kilometers in their rover and gathered 110 kg of soil and rock samples.

image.alt: Harrison Schmitt beside the flag at Taurus-Littrow, with the Lunar Module and Lunar Roving Vehicle in the background
